ltv_slabs._note: Standard RBI three-slab (same as HDFC/ICICI, unlike SBI's two-slab). Boundaries <=30L, 30-75L, >75L. On property value.
ltv_slabs._source: Axis blog on LTV (axis.bank.in) - describes RBI standard, values match RBI ceiling Axis follows.

max_tenure_years._note: Max 30 years, subject to max age at maturity (65) - whichever caps first

retirement_age._note: Standard Home Loan: max age 65 for ALL. Salaried: 'under 65 or retirement whichever earlier'. VARIANTS DIFFER: Saakaar loan (Govt/Defense) goes to 75. Modeling Standard only. Strictest of four on standard product.

min_cibil._source: Axis rate page (axis.bank.in) - no hard floor stated
min_cibil._note: NO hard CIBIL floor. Rate page prices 'Between 750 and below / No credit history' at 8.20-9.10% - Axis LENDS to no-history borrowers, rate-loads rather than declines. Unlike ICICI's hard 700 gate; like HDFC's soft gradient. 751+ gets best rate.

processing_fee.rule: up to 1% or Rs 10,000, whichever HIGHER (floor) + GST
processing_fee._note: Up to 1% or Rs10,000 whichever higher + GST. PRICIER than HDFC/ICICI (0.5%) and SBI (tiered flat) on larger loans. Admin charge Rs0. ASHA HL variant 1-2% not modeled. Other charges deferred.

rate_band._note: REPO-linked. CIBIL 751+ gets 8.00-8.85%; 750-or-below/no-history gets 8.20-9.10%. Prime rate 8.00% - between HDFC (7.75) and ICICI (8.50), above SBI (7.25). Narrow-banded like ICICI.
rate_band._source: Axis home loan interest rate page (axis.bank.in)

foir_by_income_band._note: FOIR cap varies by income - proprietary, DSA-gated

salaried: 6 months pay slip / 2 yrs bonus proof if variable pay
6 months bank statement showing salary credits
2 yrs Form 16 or employment continuity proof
self_employed_professional: ITR 2 years with Computation, P&L, Balance Sheet (CA seal/sign)
Tax Audit Report if turnover >1Cr or receipts >25L
self_employed_non_professional: ITR 2 years with Computation, P&L, Balance Sheet (CA seal/sign)
Tax Audit Report if turnover >1Cr or receipts >25L
accepted_income_proofs._note: From Axis official brochure. Self-employed 2 yrs ITR (lighter than SBI's 3). Variable-pay rule: 2 yrs bonus proof if variable. Tax audit only if turnover>1Cr/receipts>25L. DEFERRED sub-cases: NRI, Balance Transfer, partner/director corporate docs, Asha HL (1yr ITR). Lease Rental Discounting out of scope.
accepted_income_proofs._source: Axis product brochure 'Mortgages Ready Reckoner' p7 (axis.bank.in)

co_applicant_clubbing._note: Key remediation lever for FOIR-bound buyers. Haircut % and allowed relationships lender-specific - DSA-gated.
